title: Alex McGohan
text:
Introduction
Hello everyone, I’m Alex! I’m a junior at St. Olaf College studying Mathematics, Statistics, and Data Science. My academic and career interests include applied math, specifically probability, statistical modeling, and data analysis. With these interests, I have hopes of becoming an actuary.
Outside of the classroom, I play percussion in the St. Olaf Band and the St. Olaf Orchestra, and I am a big Minnesota sports fan.
